entries.20f219e486fbfd57: This business manufactures and sells clutches, brakes and similar products for the motor, speed changer and reducer, lifting and conveying machinery, and OA equipment industries, among others. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥12,308 million. The consolidated subsidiary Ogura Seiko Denshi (Dongguan) Co., Ltd. and others manufacture and sell products for general industry.
entries.2130d2046e7a6484: The company's basic policy is to build a solid corporate foundation as a comprehensive clutch and brake manufacturer and to become a company that customers love. Its medium-term management strategy states that it will expand product lines in the transport equipment business, including powertrain solenoids compatible with electrification and blowers for fuel cells, and in the general industrial business it will advance product development and sales expansion for growth markets such as collaborative robots. It also states that it will focus on selected products and markets and enhance profitability management.

entries.925fcd3f72601345: The company's statement that the manufacturing technology it has cultivated over more than 80 years can be combined across the boundary between transport equipment and general industrial use, and its policy of continuing investment in friction material development, indicate a technology base common to both businesses. Under research and development activities, the development of a variety of vehicle clutches, actuators and solenoids is cited for the transport equipment business, and the development of non-excitation-operated brakes for the robot market is cited for the general industrial business.

entries.9e827ab1d2bae6bd: There are two reportable segments: the transport equipment business (revenue from external customers of ¥28,866 million) and the general industrial business (¥12,308 million), and excluding the ¥490 million from other businesses, most revenue comes from the transport equipment business. Revenue by region is ¥19,931 million for Japan, ¥8,311 million for the United States, ¥4,565 million for China, ¥4,300 million for Asia (excluding China), ¥2,758 million for Europe and ¥1,798 million for other regions. Under information by major customer, it is stated that no customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue.
